dataset: PAMIR PX4 public incident benchmark v0.1
source_policy: Only publicly shared PX4 Flight Review logs with an accompanying public incident narrative are included.

cases.known_narrative: Motor stopped during flight; recurrence led to a fatal crash. Discussion also notes magnetometer publishing/failover anomalies.
cases.validation_goal: PAMIR should place the earliest material control/sensor deviation before downstream attitude/position loss.

cases.known_narrative: Mission flight entered flight termination after datalink/GPS-lost logic; pilot takeover did not recover motors.
cases.validation_goal: PAMIR should identify the first telemetry deviation preceding flight termination and preserve event ordering.

cases.known_narrative: Hybrid VTOL exited offboard into failsafe return; fixed-wing motor RPM remained constant and the vehicle crashed.
cases.validation_goal: PAMIR should distinguish actuator/control anomalies from subsequent trajectory deviation.

cases.known_narrative: Hexacopter began spinning in position mode; issue discussion focuses on magnetometer switching/heading behavior.
cases.validation_goal: PAMIR should surface estimation/heading deviation before attitude and motion consequences when present.

cases.known_narrative: Successful mission-mode flight on the same platform with a datalink.
cases.validation_goal: Control false-positive rate should remain materially lower than incident cases.
